name: Rare UI
summary: Shadcn registry of 24+ rare animated React components and blocks built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.
description: A shadcn registry of ready-to-use animated components — gooey nav, sidebars, AI orbs, OTP input, FAQ and more. Install with the shadcn CLI or via MCP (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex); each component is a single file you own, animated with Motion and honouring prefers-reduced-motion.
contains: 24+ components across display, AI kit, navigation, inputs and feedback categories
install with the shadcn CLI or via MCP
single-file components you own — no package dependency
built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Motion
free and sponsor-funded; license is MIT with the Commons Clause and an attribution requirement
